name: Label
description: An accessible label component built on @radix-ui/react-label. Uses class-variance-authority for variant-based styling. Automatically disables visual appearance when its associated peer input is disabled.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with the label variant styles via cn().

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The id of the form element this label is associated with. Inherited from Radix LabelPrimitive.Root.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All Radix Label primitive props and class-variance-authority variant props are forwarded.

accessibility.role: Renders a native <label> element via Radix, providing implicit label semantics.
accessibility.keyboard: Clicking the label focuses or activates the associated form control.
accessibility.aria: Radix Label handles the htmlFor/id association automatically when used with Radix form primitives.
accessibility.notes: When a peer input is disabled (peer-disabled), the label reduces opacity to 70% and shows a not-allowed cursor. Base style is text-sm font-medium leading-none.
